scope: Known synthetic linear development data; not an independent final test

protocol.origin: last training calibration per asset; fixed for all its test targets
protocol.family_pool: training prefixes only, filtered by calendar date <= each forecast origin; includes target asset

models.B1: mean of eligible asset endpoint slopes in same family

protocol.normalization: prediction residual divided by positive tolerance at forecast origin
protocol.pooled_metric: micro average of normalized forecast errors
